QF.id: XXVA Sales and Distribution of Research Services_11

question.text: A research entity that has agreed to participate as an underwriter of an issuer's IPO shall not publish research on that issuer until:

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 18(2) provides that a research entity participating as an underwriter in an IPO shall not publish research on that issuer until expiry of 25 days from the date of the offering. The Trap: Other commonly seen periods (5, 10, or 45 days) do not match the 25-day window prescribed for underwriter participation in an IPO. Note: The cooling-off period is meant to insulate post-offering research from the entity's role in the underwriting, so timing checks for IPO-related research should be tied to the offering date itself.
